Get the number one casino game of chance, Baccarat. All player moves are determined by the luck of the cards the player is dealt.

Baccarat is a very popular game among high rollers. Upgrade to the full game to access the VIP room.

467892.overview:
Online CO-OP Survival Game with Epic Boss battles, Mini-Boss battles, while fighting up to 300 zombie pigs.

Unlock and equip an assortment of weapons and pickups to defend yourself against waves of undead zombies.

Can you survive 50+ Days and Nights of blood and carnage?

467909.overview:
Wryn is a girl with purple hair and a big dream: she wants to be the ultimate videogame heroine. She also happens to have a large arsenal of weapons, so she starts a journey to take down the Greatest Heroes of All Time and claim the title for herself.

Bleed is a fast 2D side-scrolling action game with traditional gameplay elements such as running, jumping, shooting and avoiding enemies and other obstacles. The game consists of seven levels and has four difficulty settings. Besides the "normal" game mode there is also an arcade mode (just one life), a challenge mode (battle three bosses at once), and a local two-player co-op mode. There are also three unlockable characters.

467919.overview:
Bacto is a Eat'Em Up game where the player as a white cell will clean the area from bacterial infection by eating and killing nasty bacterias.

There are powerups in help for attacks and health. Each level will get more infected and be aware of highly lethal antibiotics.

The high score list is shared global with Xbox Live Gold.

467920.overview: Bad Atom is a 3D Sci-Fi shooter where David Malcolm, a well respected pilot, takes on the responsibility to help create an experimental intergalactic weapon.

467921.overview:
Don't let the name fool you! "Bad Golf" is a fun, physics-based 2D golf game.

Play a relaxing round by yourself, or a frantic golf race with up to four players!

467922.overview: Bacterio is 3D action puzzle game. You should avoid fallen blocks, eat and separate for making the road to the goal. Survive!

467923.overview:
Come for the missiles, stay for the lasers.

Help Bad Bunny defend his humble hole from an onslaught of fascist good bunnies. Spoiler alert, you will eventually fail but its the effort that counts.

467924.overview:
Partake in a 2D retro action the likes of which hasn’t been seen since the collapse of the arcades decades ago. Experience intense non-stop action as you fight off space insect hordes, collect weapons and power-ups, and battle for high score bragging rights against the entire world. And you know, save mankind from extinction at the hands of caterpillars, scorpions, spiders, and a slew of other ill-tempered giant killer insects.

"Bad Caterpillar is the game you deserve, but also the one you need."
- Commissioner Gordman

467926.overview: When the rich get poor they get a Bailout! Collect as much money as possible as it falls from the sky while avoiding suicidal stockbrokers. Don't forget to kick the homeless before they steal your free government money and use it for medical treatment. Get a job, hippies!

467927.overview: Help the king of BALATE Sir Bradimir, and his court wizard Nerdin, to defend their country by the wrath of ferocious legions of orcs coming for their life. Be ready to fight the orcs by throwing 'Balates' to them, to make them fall down to the ground.

467928.overview:
Help navigate Ball Guy through the perilous dangers of inter-dimensional time travel, or something like that.

Defeat the Evil Ball and save Pinky, or maybe everything isn't what it seems. Try to collect the hourglasses in all the stages within the given amount of boosts and enjoy some fun facts along the way.

467929.overview: Strap on your snow pants and get ready for the best sled ride of your life. Six high speed hills and satisfying unlockable features make this an adrenaline spiked adventure for gamers of any skill degree. Tour the beautiful mountains of Colorado at breakneck speeds alone or in two player mode while you enjoy hours of gaming fun and don't be afraid to...BAIL!

467930.overview:
Easy to learn, challenging to master, Ball Lightning is the first title in the "simple.fun" campaign series.

Test your reflexes and your wits across seven increasingly difficult levels in this arcade-style platformer from Amalgamation Softworks.

Collect power-ups, avoid traps and other obstacles, rescue your wizard, and escape the dungeon!

467931.overview:
Build a track in realtime and let the ball hits the barrel.

45 levels. 5 game mode.

A very new game type.

467936.overview:
Balloon Blocks is an inviting, easy to play and hard to master Match-3 game that uses soft body physics that give it a unique feel and intuitive game play.

The game has 3 game play modes and 3 difficulty levels as well as a custom game mode that gives the player over 100 different combination of options.

467937.overview:
Ballochet pits you against girders and beams within intriguing cityscapes, and expects you to hit a target. You'll also need to negotiate crates that are in the way.

There are 25 screens, each of which gives you five different balls with which you can attempt to hit the target. There's a time limit, so you need take careful aim.

This may be the most addictive game that you have ever played.

467938.overview: The Balloon Princess needs your help. An evil lord has exiled her from the Balloon Kingdom and has sent the sinister Balloon Agents to stop her return. Help her avoid Balloon Agents and return her safely to the Balloon Kingdom! Balloon Guard is a platformer with a twist. While conquering various platforming challenges, you must also bounce the Balloon Princess along while keeping her safe.

467939.overview:
This game pits you against stunning cityscapes. Can you navigate the beams to hit the target?

49 levels give you hours and hours of riveting play time. Winning the game is easy. Just aim and fire. But the simplicity is deceiving as every level has to be mastered in its own way.

Have fun!

467940.overview: Addictive but fun maze game where you have to complete the level and control the ball to push and bounce to your target.

467941.overview:
Those pesky balls have escaped! Oh no! What could we do? All you have are an unlimited supply of walls. Hmmm, Maybe you could trap the balls with the walls?

Includes 2 distinct game modes, HighScores, and Unlimited content through procedural level generation in both game modes.

467942.overview:
Expect spectacular battles in the most beautiful place in the entire universe!

In a hitherto unprecedented monotonous scenery and the unique one-level system, you must shoot at everything that moves.

467943.overview: A young boy has run away from his parents. Well not run away so much as fly away in a balloon. Guide the boy safely through the dangerous skies and away from his troubles. Compete against the world with global high scores. Only you can boost TV news ratings!

467944.overview: If you got what it takes then take what you got and throw yourself in to the wild intense world of Ball Wing. Bounce your balls on enemies and try to survive so you can get the highest highscore in this intense puzzle shooter that will challenge both your reflexes and your intellect.

467945.overview:
After a wonderful theatre performance, balloons start falling from the ceiling.

Pop as many balloons as possible in the given time.

467946.overview: In the burning light of a rainbow, fight the evil forces of shadows. Test your skills in four worlds of unique gameplay. Play in a dangerous ballet, detonate gears of shadows, avoid monstrous clouds and fight an epic war to liberate the rainbow from its foes.

467952.overview: Retrieve your coins from the farm, but be careful as the farmer has sent out his helicopters to try and stop you claiming back the coins that are rightfully yours. Make sure you storm the barns to get all the coins you can. Includes global Hi-Score table

467953.overview: In a world where colored balls constantly fly at you, a paddle is the only answer. Take control of your destiny in this exciting 4 player ball blocking extravaganza. Feast your eyes on the 8 different paddle color options. Feast your ears on the 5 sound effects. And seriously feast your brain on the seemingly limitless game modes you can create with complete control over the game's rules.

467954.overview: Banana Split is a 2D Puzzle/Platformer set in the exciting world of BREAKFAST! You play as Ben Ana, a banana with a top hat and a mission. That mission is to stop the unhealthy breakfast foods from turning breakfast into a bad meal. Ben will jump on heads and solve puzzles through five different zones across more than 50 levels in his quest to save his fruity buddies and rescue the princess.

467955.overview: Chug your beer as fast as you can! Drink too much without burping and you'll puke, wasting valuable drinking time! Punch your opponents while they're burping to make THEM puke! Test your drinking skills against up to three other human or computer players at five difficulty levels!

467957.overview: Basketball Machine is a virtual recreation of a foosball-style arcade basketball game. The court has a number of holes, and the player can launch the ball from a hole by clicking on it when the ball is resting in it. There are single- and two-player versus modes, as well as a single-player time attack mode where the goal is get as many points as possible within one minute.

467958.overview: Up to 4 players compete in a classic falling block style game, only this time players interact with each other by completing lines containing attack blocks. 20 unique attack blocks can change the game in an instant.

467959.overview: The zombie apocalypse? This may be it. This might be your only training. Don't go down without a fight!

467960.overview: Basketball Trick Shot is a physics based game. The goal is simple... put the ball in the basket. Challenge yourself with the 20 pre-built levels or create your own levels for timeless fun!

467961.overview: A twist on the tried and true classic. Blast your opponent in an attempt to get the ball past him. Battle the computer or a friend in two player mode. Or try the survival mode and try to beat your best score. Play at five unique locations. All programming and art by Jordan Hample.

467965.overview: Can you keep the beat and crush your foes? Using instrument-based controllers, Battle Beat combines the action of rhythm games with strategic elements to create a unique gameplay experience. Choose your squads and duke it out over the fate of your nondescript post-apocalyptic home world, fighting off massive hordes of aliens!

467966.overview:
Battle Cubes is a fast paced, action packed, multiplayer first person shooter that combines the best features from classic and modern games.

Play on Xbox Live with 16 of your friends or 31 via System Link! Have a second player drop in at any point and play with up to 2 players split screen.

You can customize your cuboid with hats!

Includes CO-OP and Competitive game modes!

467967.overview: Battle Bubbles (Four Corners) is set on a single-screen board with hexagonal fields. Each of the up to four players tries to seize as many fields as possible. This is accomplished by moving the controlled bubble over the screen, collecting floating blocks and place them into a free field which is adjacent to an already occupied field (each player starts the match with one). Then a timer starts and when it is expired, the field becomes fixed - but during this time, the block can be snatched away by another player. In addition to regular blocks, there are also special blocks which have positive or negative effects when placed, e.g. fast or slow speed. As soon as a block is picked up, the bubble becomes solid and can collide with other player bubbles. Each match ends after a certain time and the player with the most points wins. Points are rewarded for placing and stealing blocks, but having a block stolen results in a point subtraction.

467978.overview:
Never played a good submarine game? Ever thought 2D shooters are boring? They don't have to be! Battle Sub combines colourful artwork and compelling gameplay to create a unique experience in underwater combat.

Quests are the corner stone of this game, propelling the player forward in the story line as they help defend each ocean against the empire.

467979.overview:
Battle Tanks is a top-down action game with tanks. The tank is controlled with the standard dual-stick style (one stick controls movement and the other aim) and, in addition to the regular shot with unlimited ammo, can also drop mines behind. However, just as ricochet bullets, they can also be harmful to the player's tank. When two bullets meet, they cancel each other out. Picking up spawning power-ups give permanent or temporary upgrades, e.g. invisibility, higher speed, rockets or a flame thrower.

All maps are basically single-screen arena maps. During the single-player campaign, 50 levels have to be solved by killing all opposition. In later levels not only the AI opponents and the time limit of two minutes may cause problems, but also environmental obstacles, e.g. conveyor belts, mud which slows down movement or crushing walls.

In multiplayer, up to four players can engage in deathmatch, team deathmatch or capture the flag matches. Optionally destroyed tanks can be turned into turrets so players can throw a few bombs while they are out. The multiplayer modes can also be played against bots.

467980.overview:
The city has been taken by an army of demons! You are its only hope, as all other law enforcing units, even from nearby regions, were neutralized during the attack while you were out of town, attending a disciplinary hearing.

Your mission is to go in, vanquish the invading army, punish those responsible for such riot, restore the peace and order in the city... and then return to your hearing.

467981.overview: Battle Havoc is a fast paced multi-player action game with a unique twist on real-time artillery combat. Take to the air with rechargeable jets unleashing the power of over 20 different weapons and upgrades. Play Deathmatch or Elimination modes against 8 players over LIVE, System Link, or a single Xbox. Earn coveted Gold Medals as you race against the clock in 13 single-player time challenges.

467982.overview: At San Bruno High School, a vicious gang known as "The Rivals" reigns supreme, terrorizing and oppressing their peers undetected and unpunished. Choose from 8 students as they battle for justice or greed in this fast-paced 2D fighter.

467983.overview: 1-4 Player Multi-Platform 2-D Fighting greatness! Think of this as Battle-X featuring better backgrounds, remixed music and new moves for all characters. Multiple levels of difficulty are also available. Counters, block breakers, and Super Combos are some of the new features that make Battle-SX an action pack slugfest.

467986.overview: The sequel to Battle High: Elemental Revolt, this thrilling fighter introduces 5 new characters, new music and stages, new challenges, and awesome voice-acting! Play as one of 12 fierce students (and one secretive faculty member) as they face-off in the tough halls of San Bruno High for the Elementally Advanced and discover the secret behind the mysterious illness stripping students of their powers!

467987.overview: Beer Pong 2 introduces trickshot levels that allow you to collect caps and purchase upgrades. Upgrades include Ball variations, gravity controls, spin controls, ball paths and more that can all be used in Classic play. Using the new Minimap feature, you can now view the entire field to better aim your shot!

467990.overview: Bed Time Nursery Rhymes for your children.

467991.overview: Battleships? Phaw! Instead of trying to sink your opponent's ships, try to squish his or her worms? A fun twist on this classic board game. Squish all the worms in your opponent's garden before he can squish all of yours. Happy stomping!

467992.overview: Play Beer Pong with your friends! Either test your skill against a computer, or play with up to 4 players in a two on two match. Cup and drink counter will keep track of how many shots you've sinked as well as how many drinks you've had. Trickshot lets you test your skills against different style cups like a champagne glass or shot glass!

467993.overview:
4 different modes to battle with friends. Sink, loot and beat them to see who is the real pirate!

BattleShip Arcade is for playing with friends and family up to 4 on the same screen!

467994.overview: A first person shooter challenge game. Take turns to see who can kill the most penguins before the penguins kill you.

467995.overview: BeatBlox is a music-oriented action-puzzle game where you scramble to match blocks to the beat of a wide variety of music. Are you ready?

467996.overview:
BattleSweeper is a straight Minesweeper variant. There is a grid and each time the player clicks on a field, the game either ends (a hidden bomb was found) or a number is revealed. This number shows how many bombs are found in the direct vicinity. Using those hints, the player has to work out where the bombs are hidden. Flags are used to mark the bomb spots. The game successfully ends when all fields without bombs are revealed.

This variant features three competitive multiplayer modes: Gems (the players needs to find as many hidden gems as possible), Survive (every player has three lives and no flags) and Zones (the goal is to uncover the largest area).

467997.overview:
Battlepaths is a loot-centric and addictive 2D-RPG featuring neat monster hacking, an excellent loot system and a huge variety of character development. Learn skills, use powerfull potions, and hunt down the Chaos Overlord. The battle begins in Babatula, the first of three big realms to explore.

Battlepaths offers a sophisticated drop system that generates countless different items along with more than 50 unique items. The character customization allows you to create a unique hero with its own strengths and weaknesses. You can build a heavy, damage dealing tank, a deadly ninja that utilizes high speed and agility to attack his victims from out of nowhere, a true master of mind who crushes his foes with powerful combinations of special abilities, or something in between.

You can choose to play in different realms that each have their own landscape and their own set of creatures. The many superior items you will find can be exchanged between different characters, one of which will eventually become the first powerful enough to face the Chaos Overlord.

467998.overview:
Beat Hazard Ultra is a release of the game that was previously available for the Xbox 360 as an indie title and then on PC. It is a twin-stick shooter where the player controls a space ship in a single screen arena with randomly generated enemies and power-ups based on the music that is playing. Music is provided in-game but can also consist of custom tracks stored by the user on the device or hard disk. For the Android version it is also possible to play along an internet radio station.

As a whole, the game largely incorporates the content and features of the original Beat Hazard game along with the Beat Hazard: Ultra add-on, in a single game. The add-on for instance introduced head-to-head and cooperative multiplayer games (PS3, not for the mobile versions), also with the Boss Rush, Chill Out and Survival game modes. All versions come with perks that can be unlocked in-game and achievements/trophies. For the mobile versions there are two ways to control the game: either as a one-stick mode for beginners or a twin-stick mode or advanced players. The game also includes a music visualizer without gameplay.

467999.overview: Can you be the Beach Paddle champion?

468000.overview: Beach Bubbles is a simple action game where the player must maneuver a cute girl around the field collecting bubbles while avoiding bouncing around the open space. Collect all the bubbles on the stage without getting hit, and part of an illustration of a girl in a bikini is unlocked -- clear all the stages, and the full illustration is shown. There are a total of nine girls to see, with six stages for each.

468001.overview:
The bears are befuddled! Help these batty bears blast their way through challenges in this puzzle, arcade-shooter.

Follow the bears' escapades in story mode, and play with - or against - three friends in local multi-player. Along the way, unlock a bunch of bears and weapons, each with unique strategies to master. Did we mention cookies would be involved?

The bears need you - don't let them down!

468002.overview:
The evil Zargon has captured Being's friends and the magical star pieces. Somehow this will enable him to rule the galaxy, so Being has to stop him.

Being is a traditional side-scrolling platformer. The player character can move horizontally, jump on platforms, collect coins as well as keys. The latter are required to open same-colored doors. Enemies can't be defeated and have to be avoided, otherwise one of the three hearts of life energy is removed. At the end of a level waits one of Being's friends and a star piece to collect.

468003.overview:
bbbbb is the ungodly rhythm game child of running platformers, Rock Band and gravity flipping.

Each lane controls an instrument, each button controls a character in a lane. Flip characters avoiding the spikes and keep the music going. And every so often there’s the wheel of fortune: characters are moved into new positions. There’s only a few seconds to get ready for the next onslaught.

468004.overview: Bible Navigator X: HCSB is the first application on the XBOX 360 that allows the user to read the entire Bible from their 360. Featuring easy navigation, bookmarks, and search tools, Bible Naviagtor X presents the HCSB translation in a great way to read scripture. Various settings allow you to customize the reading experience with different themes, font sizes, and a scalable viewing area.

468010.overview: This screensaver looks like a glass of ice cold beer. Put it up at a party for the perfect atmosphere.

468022.overview: Test your knowledge of the Bible with hundreds of trivia questions from the Old Testament and the New Testament. Easy and hard levels to choose from. Bonus mini-games are awarded after every round of 25 questions. Great for Bible study or family entertainment.

468023.overview: Bid Whist, this is a form of Rummy and had been played in Urban areas for quite some time. Tournament play makes this a must have for your game collection!

468024.overview: Welcome to Bible Trivia - Avatar Edition, where you and your friends can test your knowledge of Biblical truths from the comfort of our living room. So grab a controller, get comfy, and let's get going.

468026.overview: Welcome to the working world. We're gonna leverage your synergy and have you shove some boxes around for some reason. There's free coffee in the break room.

468028.overview:
Bibz is a multiplayer party platform brawler with lots of unlockables and customizable characters.

Artwork is by kids in Ethiopia, Australia, and Canada.

468030.overview: Grab your friends and duel it out in three action-packed mini-games! Test your reactions in 'Wastefall'. Put your memory to the test in 'Carnundrum' and hone your button bashing skills in 'Poodamonium'!

468032.overview: It is 1944 and the axis forces have managed to get hold of alien 'Foo Fighter' technology. The aliens are helping them to build anti-gravity battleships in their secret underground base in the Nevada desert. This would allow them to alter the course of the war. Billy must stop them from altering the future and help the allies win the war ...... again!

468035.overview: Birth Order is a horizontal scrolling shoot'em up with a few twists. Twelve different stage types could be on your path to the final fight. You can pick up cards, that can be played out between the stages, to give you even more power or help out in other ways. Each enemy is controlled by a color coded letter, the only way to destroy it is to press the corresponding button on the game pad.

468036.overview: Take on the role of a professional hacker who has finally released him/herself into the internet after many years of studying hacking. Fight your way through, avoiding viruses and worms - or even other hackers - along with breaking firewalls to reach your destination.

468037.overview:
TauCorp Pharmacuticals [sic] developed medical nanobots. The player is one of those and is sent on missions to kill stuff. In practice, this is a survival mode. The controls follow the usual twin-stick shooter conventions and there are some special moves available: blackhole (sucks in everything, including the player), blast and a lightning attack. Those have a cooldown period after usage.

Additionally there are a number of versus modes against other players or the AI available, for example turrets (the players can deploy turrets), wire cycle (players leave hazardous trails behind them), lasso (similar to wire cycle, but the trails disappear after a time), froghop (checkpoint races) or worms (getting close, but don't touch, worms which fly around the playfield).

468038.overview:
It is a TPS (Third Person Shooter).

Defeat the crazy monsters that approach you! As you progress through the stages, the city changes its appearance...

468039.overview:
Bingo!

Play with up to 4 people and with up to 10 cards each.

468040.overview:
Play as Dougal McTaggart, an intrepid adventurer caught up in a magical world of cubes! Place over 50 block types including TNT, Ladders, Water, Lava and Sheep!

Take in-game photos and show them off to your friends in the gallery, and let your imagination take over in this ultimate block-building game!

468041.overview: A bird murdered the protagonist's father, so he has dedicated himself to killing every bird he can find. The player controls the protagonist, who can move, jump, and shoot. Avoid obstacles and kill birds to make money, which can be used to buy better guns and other upgrades, to kill birds more efficiently.

468042.overview:
Build your small town into a bustling metropolis using the power of virtual currency.

Starting with only a small hot-dog stall, you must accumulate Bitcoin, breed Alpacas, build Hydroelectric power stations, and wrangle with Red Tape to create a thriving city.

468043.overview:
Billy's Job is an arcade game.

Your task is to store all the object in the room. For this, push them on the conveyor belt. When all is done take the key to next levels.

Features:
-Over 25 Levels
-Continue support
-Highscore online

468044.overview:
We've all played physics-based games before. But have you ever tried one based on biochemical kinetics?

BioHack is a simulation game where you must solve challenging design problems. The game includes 25 unique levels, plus randomly-generated mutant levels.

No science background necessary!

468045.overview: Enjoy four different types of Bingo with up to 31 players in a game. With over 50 different winning patterns and plenty of unlockable items, everyone has fun with Bingo Party!

468046.overview: Bit Crunch is a retro style twin stick shooter that focuses on exploration and adaptation. Players are given a sprite and stats based on their name and pushed into an ever changing world. Tasked with retrieving an orb from the boss, players set out against rooms and waves of enemies who get more powerful with each new room that's explored.

468047.overview: You have heard the stories about people going to Vegas, counting cards, and getting rich. To bad you can't keep dozens of numbers and probability tables in you head. Let your Xbox will take care of the details of keeping track of the cards and sorting thru the tens of thousands of possible hands to calculate the odds. You are free to mastermind the strategy. Can you achieve simulated riches?

468048.overview: Feel the beat as you weave your way through the pounding techno race tracks of the Bitstream universe. With 4 tournaments spread over 16 challenging courses, it'll take all your skill to defeat your rival racers and claim the title of ultimate Bitstream champion!Bitstream takes classic vector line racing gameplay and gives it a unique audio-sensory makeover. Each movement by both the player and the AI racers is accompanied by beat matched audio cues, which build into a constantly evolving, dynamic sound-scape that ebbs and flows as the race progresses.The full version of Bitstream includes:- 16 unique tracks- 4 challenging tournaments- Freestyle music generator mode- Gamecenter leaderboards and achievements

468049.overview: Blackjack Strategy King has plenty of help and tips for beginners, and advanced features for experienced players. Features include Basic Strategy, Card Counting, Simulation, Awards, and Cheating. Player can define custom strategies or use the default. Includes options for Bank, Table Limits, Hit Soft 17, Surrender, Number of Decks, and more.

468050.overview:
"It's Super Smash Strategy!" in a fast-paced Real Time Strategy game featuring chaotic 4-player local multiplayer, a full single player campaign including an insidious AI, and fully customisable characters!

Build your army using the 4 unit types to outmaneuver your foes in an RTS designed specifically for console.

468055.overview: Here is your chance to go to a super elite business school and earn an MBA. However, Future Robber Barons University is like no other business school. It is not about lectures and exams. There is only one test and only one thing that counts - can you make money? How much? 1 Billion dollars in four years or you flunk out.

468060.overview: Bizzy Bee is a one or two player co-op game where you and a friend race to collect pollen from fields of flowers in the shortest amount of time.

468061.overview: Based on the classic asteroids model, BlastaRock! From Reaper Gaming Studios is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter. Play through the campaign to unlock more powerful weapons and equipment, then take your ship to battle in survival mode. Featuring 2-player local multiplayer, online scoreboards, and RGS Awardments.

468062.overview: Bounce your way along the cosmic path, collecting coins and trying to beat the clock in this 3D bounce-along pick-up-and-play knockabout!

468063.overview: Destroy thousands of blocks through 50 levels of increasing difficulty with this retro style game! Includes many items and bonuses such as multiball, expand paddle, laser and much more!

468064.overview: The Blaggers is a single-screen platformer. In each level, the protagonist first has to collect all keys so he can open the exit door. Of course there are several obstacles in the way such as hazardous objects, moving enemies (which don't actively target the player), conveyor belts or platforms which dissolve after stepping on them. Each contact with something dangerous results as instant death and the need to start the level over. There is also a time limit.

468065.overview: Blaster and Morion is a sci-fi themed twin stick shooter, and the sequel to Blaster and Amethyst. Playing much like its predecessor, the goal of each of the seven stages is to blast enemies off the stage, collect all seven crystals, and reach the exit before the timer runs out and without falling off the stage. As before, contact with enemies or enemy fire is not directly harmful, but will cause the character to fly backwards a good distance, and likely off the stage to his death.

468067.overview:
Classic Vector based arcade game. Power shields, Smart bombs, Extra lives.

In the 1980's games like this cost 25 cents per play and made millions, now they might make a few pennies.

If you are over the age of 30 you may have seen this game before and enjoy the nostalgia!

468068.overview:
BlindGiRl is back. This time she is not alone.

Play split-screen or with a friend to solve echo-location puzzles, and find your way through confusion to understanding.

468069.overview: Make your spinning, sizzling way along the road as fast as you can without falling through the gaps. Simple? Few will be good or fast enough to complete all 20 stunning 3D levels, but everyone can enjoy the 2-player battle mode - smack your opponent's ball around in the race to the line! Can YOU find your way to the top of the global online score table?

468070.overview: Blaster and Amethyst is a simple top-down shooting game. Each stage contains seven amethyst crystals, and the player must collect them all to open the gate to the next stage. Making this more difficult are the swarms of buglike monsters populating each stage. They will attack and shoot at the player, and while no attacks will do direct damage, they will cause the player to fly wildly, easily careening off the edge of the stage. The player has a blaster with which to ward off enemies, but this also only pushes them around and off the stage. The player is awarded with a time bonus for remaining time at the end of each stage, and there are seven stages total.

468071.overview: Action hero Buck Forrest is being forced into retirement! Help him end his career his way, in a Blaze of Glory. Blast your way through an endless stream of Thugs and Ninjas with a variety of different weapons and powerups.

468072.overview: Punch, kick, shoot and smash - in Block Slam, you use your PowerBall and Minigun to destroy all the blocks in each level. Gather Bonuses, avoid hazards and always keep your PowerBall in play - this is 3D block busting action like you've never seen before!

468073.overview:
Kill your friends, earn medals, unlock new abilities, customize your character and so much more in Block Ops!

Fight Zombies together, duel 16 players at once in Deathmatch or show off your strategy in Flag King.

468074.overview:
The block's are getting their revenge! Take control and move between four fields at once and try to keep the fields up and alive.

The timer keeps ticking, boss blocks keep dropping, prolong the block menace as long as possible!

Features visual and audio changes to keep the pacing up, along with classic and two player competitive modes.

468075.overview: In Block the Laser, your goal is to reach the exit while evading deadly lasers along the way. To accomplish this youll have to step on floor buttons to turn lasers on or off, open and close doors, or activate turnstiles which push anything that stand in their way. You can also manipulate mirrors to redirect the lasers path or use doors and turnstiles to block the laser.

468077.overview: The premise is simple, hit a ball with a paddle to take out your opponents blocks so you can get a single ball by his wall to win. Things heat up quickly with multi-ball action. Ping-Pong on Steroids. It's simple, it's fun, and it's addicting! Have Fun!!

468078.overview: Kill blocks, save the world! Block Killer is what 1980 thought we'd be playing in 2010. Classic, single stick movement, simple push button shooting. Over 30 levels of arcade-style action! Do you have what it takes?

468079.overview:
Blackstone Part I is the first in a trilogy of adventure games in which you take on the role of our heroine Kate, the innocent and unknowing victim of an evil sorcerer's attempt to harness the powers of the mysterious Blackstone. As she embarks on a brave mission to save her village and help her friends, her quest soon leads her to the Clouded Mountain where she must discover both the true extent of her task and the real reason Blackstone is so desperately coveted.

You control Kate as she starts in her home village and then moves through the different areas of the game. You must help her find, pick up and use items, solve puzzles and meet lots of new faces on her journey. The story unfolds as you progress in the game, and is shown via multiple cut sequences in fantastic 3D with full character voiceovers.

Blackstone was available for the Xbox 360 and was released in July 2011. It remained there until the marketplace closed in October 2017, and is no longer available on any platform.

468080.overview:
Blast the floor out from under your opponents' feet to send them to their doom; before they do the same to you. Will you risk an early loss to grab the power up and gain an advantage?

Unlock dozens of models and skins as you defeat online opponents or computer controlled bots. Show off your new looks while sniping the floor out from under your friends' feet.

Play with up to 8 people in each match.

468081.overview:
Experience a unique 8 Player FPS DeathMatches that breaks all the rules you're used to, as well as the ground beneath you!

Test your skills offline against challenging bots or with a friend. Split screen is supported.

Double XP Weekends!

New levels and powerups get patched in weekly!

468083.overview: Block Smash is a challenging block puzzler. The idea of the game is to get three blocks of the same color in a horizontal or vertical row in order to remove them from the grid. For each level you are given a certain amount of blocks to use in order to complete the level.

468084.overview:
Imagine breakout, except this time the blocks aren't as happy about you firing balls in their directions and are fighting back!

Collect power-ups to get back in the fight and juggle as many balls as you can to get extra points. Battle through 10 Levels of 3 stages each in arcade mode, take on survival mode, or play versus another player.

468085.overview: You and your friends create worlds in BlockWorld. With the best graphics, largest worlds and most items you can do anything you want. Unlock new blocks and items with Awards in uniquely generated worlds during the day and night in BlockWorld. Swords, Arrows, bombs and Guns let you challenge your friends to combat and destruction in BlockWorld.

468086.overview: An intriguing mix of puzzle solving, adventuring, and strategy, BlindGiRl puts the player in the shoes of a girl lost in a world of darkness, where the unknown lurks around every corner.

468087.overview:
Jump blocks, draw blocks, and get to the top in this intense platformer!

Fall off the screen and fail, or succeed in reaching the top as fast as you can, but beware; this game is HARD!

468089.overview:
Block Shift is a puzzle game requiring you to piece together a picture from its parts. You can move each row and column as a whole unit.

Includes over 80 puzzles including your gamer image in puzzle form! Also includes a mapmaker to build your own puzzles.

468091.overview: Block BUSTER is inspired by the old classics from the 70's. Knock out the blocks in vivid 3D. Experience over 20 challenging levels for hours of game play. Choose from 3 difficulty levels for the best experience. This is my Tribute to the great legacies of gaming!

468097.overview:
Online deathmatch with big robots, featuring huge explosions in your typical fully destructible blocky world.

Also supports CPU opponents for offline training.

468098.overview:
Online deathmatch with helicopters, featuring huge explosions in your typical fully destructible blocky world.

Also supports CPU opponents for offline training.

468099.overview:
Online deathmatch with avatars and tanks, up to 8 players! Use your big gun to explode the blocky world, or build anti-tank obstacles.

Features bots for offline training.

468100.overview: This is a retro Breakout-style game. 50 stages in all.

468101.overview:
In a world gone wrong, one girl stands alone. Alone, but not unarmed!

In a world gone wrong, one girl stands alone. Alone, but not unarmed!

Strange crystalline structures have turned people into mindless, zombie-like creatures.

Fight the Zombies! Stop the Infection! Save the Day!

Explore a variety of environments while blowing zombies into blocky bits.
Find new weapons and upgrade them, from pistol and shotgun to flamethrower and RPG.
Make use of flares, grenades and mines.
Wii U GamePad modes for off-TV play and map display.

468102.overview:
Ever wonder what two teams of right-angled people playing hockey looks like? Well look no further!

Seriously, stop looking.

468103.overview: Drop blocks into the cube. Watch the the blocks change color. Get three in a row. Eat a sandwich. Repeat.

468117.overview: The object of Blocks is to deliver a wooden create to a magical floating island using a jet-powered platform. Along the path to the island, you are confronted with obstacles designed to impede your progress. You must dodge moving blocks, squeeze through tight spaces, and turn sharp corners at blinding speeds. Blocks will rock your socks!

468118.overview: Bloody Mary, Bloody Mary, Bloody Mary.

468119.overview:
Enter the medieval world of KnottedHand Hall, and take on 20 dead NPC's who will try and stop you at all costs. Enjoy 30 hours of leveling, exploring, and hiding as you take everything you have learned online.

Gorgeous graphics and 3D gameplay almost go unnoticed as the action overtakes you, and you become immersed in volleys of spells, arrow barrages and cannon attacks from your opponents.

468120.overview:
Blocks That Matter is a 2D puzzle game where the player controls a tiny Tetrobot. The robot was designed by two independent Swedish developers, Alexey and Markus, but they have been kidnapped to work for a large corporation. Their Tetrobot invention is the only one who can save them. Players guide the robot through the different levels to reach the exit. It can be moved around and can drill many different types of blocks to collect them. Once stored, the blocks can be recycled to design new constructions and they also each have their own qualities. This technique is reminiscent of the contemporary Minecraft and is used for most of the levels to get past obstacles and reach higher platforms. Blocks cannot be reconstructed randomly. They have to be laid out in patterns called tetrominoes. Only a single block can be drilled at a time and its disappearance often affects the blocks around it. In construction as well: wood and iron blocks are stable enough to stand on their own, but a sand block will not stand unless it is supported by another block.

At any time the puzzle mode can be activated. It pauses the game and overlays the screen with a green grid. Players can then design their constructions with the available blocks without pressure. By completing levels up to 40 Blocks That Matter are collected. These awards unlock new parts of the game and reference classic games where blocks play an important role, such as Boulder Dash for instance. Not all parts of the game are slow-placed. There are chase sequences with giant monsters and different types of enemies in general. In the execution of design, classic block games are often referenced next to the use of tetrominoes, by clearing a line of blocks Tetris-style for instance.

In the Adventure Mode the main campaign is The Underground Rescue. There are also Bonus Levels and a separate menu where the game' soundtrack is unlocked. In the Community mode players can create their own levels or play custom levels designed by others.

468121.overview:
Collect all the blocks, and navigate to the goal. But be careful how you connect them -- some shapes don't roll around very well!

Featuring innovative game mechanics with 3 block types, gorgeous space nebula environments, and 75 mind-bending, fully 3D puzzles to solve.

468122.overview: Zombie killing action! Survive as many rounds as you can! Up to four players on a local machine with multiple characters, a variety of weapons, two intriguing worlds and almost certain death. Grab your friends and fight your way through the zombie devastation in a fun cartoon world with plenty of zombie killing dance music to start a revolution!

468123.overview: Take the wheel of a heavily armed speedboat as you take on enemy boats, frigates, and battleships with a multitude of weapons and upgrades including missiles, machine guns, mines, armor, engines, and more. After your first intense dog fight you wont be able to put it down!

468124.overview:
Blood And Bacon is a Multiplayer Shooter that pits heavily armed players against undead deadstock as you attempt to butcher your way through 100+ levels of insanity and twitching gristle.

Day and night levels, players will take on 25 enemy types and numerous bosses, like the gargantuan monster affectionately named, 'Princess Blubbergut' and Minibosses every 10 days as you explore, shoot and run for your life against the onslaught of porcine monstrosities.

Boasting over 15+ hours of gameplay and the ability to battle a staggering (or shambling) 500+ undead creatures at once, "Blood and Bacon" looks to feature more barnyard excitement than you can shake Old MacDonald's severed femur at!!

468125.overview:
This game was classified by the community with the following category scores - Violence=3/3, Sex=2/3, Mature Content=3/3.

Are you brave enough to bear anguish and terror? Faceless Killer is back, to end what he didn't accomplished three years ago. Fear is waiting for you just around the corner. Write your destiny, nothing is still settled..12 different dooms are waiting for you.. The new masterpiece signed by The Prince of Terror, Claudio Battiato..

468126.overview:
Let your imagination loose and create all the 3D objects you can think of with BLOCKS.

With the ONLINE SHARING feature, you can download all the community creations, and even destroy them with the BAZOOKA.

468127.overview:
Blocky is an addictive 2D arcade style game with an RPG style reward system. Easy to learn with simple game mechanics. As you perform well, you are rewarded with unlocks and currency to buy additional items.

The game has two game modes: Retro mode, only one life and try last as long as you can. Waves, a selection of levels with different goals.

An easy to play addictive game!

468131.overview: Let's bloom flower with Popo! This is a greening 3d puzzle. Rules are simple. The game is cleared if flowers can blossom in the faces of all blocks. It is a failure when stepping on the same face twice. When it is a little action frequency, it is a high score. Let's play Bloom*Block!

468132.overview:
Brave barrages of colored 'Bloops' and treacherous flying pebbles to defeat your friends in this exciting action-puzzle game.

Match Bloops on the opposing 'rock' and conquer your opponent's den. Experience match three mechanics combined with classic combat gameplay in a head to head experience that’s familiar - yet unlike anything you’ve played before.

468133.overview: Proof that dynamite is the solution to all the world's toughest problems.

468134.overview: Save your land by collecting the 3 discs of power. Stomp, crush, and plow through the insect menace to save your land. To destroy them, you must become them...via cool bug suits like the Beetle Suit, Grasshopper Suit, and Butterfly Suit.

468135.overview:
Help Blowball to save the world by stopping the evil rose and its allies in this funny Shoot 'Em Up for kids and adults.

Enjoy four different levels, tricky enemies, unique art style and impulsive music!

468136.overview: BluePrint Racer: The Next Generation is a time-based driving game in which the player navigates a car from the behind view. The gameplay takes place on a minimalistic blue, flat surface that contains only two elements: blocks that obstruct the player's view and gas cans that must be collected. Each level challenges the player to gather all gas cans before the time runs out.

468137.overview:
Blazing Forge Games puts a hardcore spin on retro paddle ball games with BlurBall - a highly competitive multiplayer game with 7 levels, up to 16 balls, and 24 paddles on a single match!

Play head to head with a friend or on a team with over 100+ unique paddles to choose from.

468138.overview: Arr! What a horrible night to have a curse. Can Bluebones find the lost gold of Davy Jones to break the curse and return to his true form? He only has until midnight, and the clock is ticking!

468143.overview: Bloc is a new twist on the top-down shooter. Destroy blocks by firing like-colored orbs while dodging a swarm of enemies.

468153.overview: Philip Muwanga proudly presents: Balls, a comprehensive bar room pool simulator for Xbox Live Indie games. Bring your avatar down to Phils fruit & Juice bar and take on all comers in games of eight ball or nine ball. Customise the games setting to match your local pool rules then challenge the world over Xbox live. Also includes Grunt Assault, and demos of HexyTrench & Extreme Jigsaw Madness

468165.overview: Join Bobbin the apple in his quest to defend his homeland against banana and orange invaders. As you battle across Starfruit Island, the real menace is revealed! Along the way, make sure to save your buddy apples! Bobbin's Quest features six vivid levels, and a comic book story line to follow. In each level there is a unique mini-game. Replay Bobbin's Quest to achieve the highest score!

468167.overview: Create your own board games and try them out with your friends online. Both new pieces and boards can be built using a simple block builder tool, like in Lootfest. There are no movement restrictions, like in real boardgames, making the editor free from scripting. Comes with 16 classic games, that can be both modified and played.

468168.overview: Boarders Beyond Borders - SnowBoard on several challenging levels.

468188.overview: Bobby says - dance with me! Repeat after Bobby and train your memory while having loads of fun. Challenge friends and family while playing up to four players. Fun for all ages!

468190.overview: You are a Bomb Disposal Expert in training. Hold your nerve while you exercise your memory and rhythm, following the light sequences. Hurry up or the bomb will explode! Play with up to eight friends (only one pad needed) in a crazy multiplayer mode. And if you start to think it's easy to defuse a bomb, try the special modes: mirror, clockwise and counterclockwise... and think again!!

468192.overview: "... like an out-of-this-world mashup of billiards and Lunar Lander ..." - iFanzineBobby the Bullet Dude is on a mission to defend the planet from the Evil Green Ball Guys in this pick and and play arcade bouncer. But don't let the simple mechanics fool you, there's nothing easy about beating this game. Make your way through 65 distinct stages with 10 Game Center achievements and you and Bobby will be part of the elite few who can claim victory over the bouncing menaces.The gameplay features the player playing as Bobby, a rocket powered, robotic bullet. The goal of the game is to find a green portal to take you to the next dimension. Green portals are normally unlocked by knocking all of the bouncing balls into the red "black hole" portals, though some levels are mazes with already unlocked portals. Various game elements exist to make your job of knocking balls into portals and navigating more fun and challenging!iPhone/iPod Touch 4 highly recommended for this game due to the retina display graphics.- Supports Joypad for using an iPod Touch or iPhone as a gamepad!- Supports 60beat GamePad on iPad/iPad2, iPhone 3GS/4/4S, and iPod Touch 4 and up- Retina display graphics- 65 crazy levels- 10 Game Center achievements- Cool music, or listen to your iPod- Slick graphics and animation- Learn good strategy- 3 star rewards system- Un-lockable character- 14 different game objects and obstacles

468198.overview: Bomber is an arcade-style 2D shooter. Shoot down airballoons with your tank and collect the goods to increase your rank! The game features 12 single-player levels and 4 unlockable challenges.

468200.overview:
Strongest futuristic racing game"BomBomEngine". Get a licence and participate in a race.

The aim is a champion. Furthermore the aim is king of the BomBomEngine.

468201.overview: Zombie defence with a twist, see how many waves of bombies you can survive in this multiplayer shooter.

468202.overview: BombLocker is a puzzle game inspired by Minesweeper, but with several improvements. Use reason, clues and hints to locate and lock bombs hidden within a field of hexagons. Each level is random, but difficulty increases as you progress. If you like sweeping mines, you will love locking bombs.

468204.overview:
Can you save the city from a not so friendly green Alien named Iggy? He loves to drop bombs off the tops of buildings. You must catch these bombs before they hit the ground. If you miss, they explode and you die.

You will receive power ups along the way. You will have to deal with explosive bombs, smoke bombs, duds and changing weather conditions.

Also included are day and night time levels!

468206.overview: Sign up to Bomber Boing championship, where strange creatures fight with no mercy for victory. Destroy the floor to finish with your rivals through its 30 scenarios with many different conditions. Ideal for playing with family, friends, or anyone with its online mode for Xbox Live!. Amazing music for an atypical and very funny game. Ready...GO!

468209.overview: Use the alien bomb squad to stop the blue wheelers from reaching the mothership.

468210.overview: Help your children learn important Biblical stories with the colorfully-illustrated Book of Biblets, the first game of a seven game series. Part 1- The Creation contains seven Old Testament stories, along with narration, story-related games, and trivia questions to test your knowledge.

468211.overview: The WORLD's #1 undead parkour racing simulator for your Xbox 360. Featuring funky fresh visuals, rockin' beats, and copious amounts of innuendo, this quirky new twist on a video gaming favourite is the full 'package'. Get BoneD or get lost!

468212.overview: Enjoy an unpredictable, wacky adventure in this turn-based RPG! Crisp graphics, quality music, hilarious dialogue and ridiculous enemies are some of the things that await you in a title that brings the classic gameplay of 8- and 16-bit RPGs into an updated look and feel!

468213.overview: Use a series of satisfying weapons to annihilate hordes of monsters in this unique "single stick" shooter. Experience 4 levels of difficulty, up to 4 player coop, local highscores, and a killer soundtrack courtesy of Razorback Records. "Boom Chick Chick", it's music to my ears.

468216.overview:
Boot Hill Heroes is the first episode in a game series that fuses elements of spaghetti western film - gunslinging outlaws, brave lawmen, and the untamed wilderness - with classic RPG storyline and gameplay. 90s console RPGs like Final Fantasy, Earthbound and Chrono Trigger created lasting memories and impacted us as gamers. Now, Boot Hill Heroes brings back those experiences while revitalizing the genre with a Wild West spin and innovative new gameplay elements.

It's an experimental combination of old and new ideas intended to bring a new and unique experience to modern gamers and old-school fans alike. It's an epic Wild West adventure packed with excitement, intrigue and a dose of humor.

468217.overview:
Boom Kikker is an addictive puzzle game!

Boom Kikker is Afrikaans for tree frog and an amazing assortment of these colorful frogs need your help returning to their pond. Place your frog tiles correctly to clear the board and win the game.

Sounds easy, right? Not so fast! 25 levels of frog mayhem will challenge even the brainiest puzzle aficionado.

468218.overview: Join Eekeemoo as he and Boopa Blast their way through the subterranean caverns of the mysterious dark planet!

468219.overview: One of the most addictive puzzle games on the net is now available for your Xbox 360. This award-winning game offers three different modes of play and hours of addictive fun! Play alone, battle the computer, or compete with friends in Party Mode!

468221.overview: Border Wars is an imaginative side-scrolling 2D Space Shooter that lets you battle through the margins of your notebook. Draw your own ship from scratch or with pre-made parts and fly it in the game. Kill enemies to earn points that can be used to purchase upgrades and customize your experience. Fight your way through 16 levels of various enemies and bosses, all to a rocking custom sound track.

468222.overview: Grab hold of this robot-zombie bashing brawler and lay waste to all who stand in your way!

468223.overview: The original BounceCrazy! Ball bouncing fun for children of all ages. Six balls on each side of the field. Try to get your balls into your opponent's goal while preventing balls from the other side from entering yours. Simple to play. Loads of fun. Play against a friend or play against the robot hand. Great for kids or adults.

468224.overview: Bouken Ou Kyuu Juu Kyuu Hyaku is an Adventure game, developed and published by Seama Rooky, which was released in 2012.

468225.overview: It's Bounce! Hit those creatures with your ball. Bounce your ball off of the wall! Try to beat that last high score, and win the game forever more!

468227.overview:
Chuy just can't seem to get it right. He's tried everything to get back to his family. Can you guide him back and help him to avoid the immigration and DEA agents?

Guide Chuy through an infinite number of routes back to the border. Gather tacos to summon the Witch, the Goat Sucker and the Boogie Man to scare away and terrorize the immigration agents.

468228.overview: Bored Meeting is a casual group game where deceptively simple game play quickly leads to fun and interesting situations.

468229.overview: Manipulate Time to survive and earn as much points as you can in a classical spaceshooter game.

468232.overview:
Bounce, jump, smash and munch across the colourful world of Bopscotch!

Challenge ninety fiendish levels solo in adventure mode, or take on a friend in head-to-head race mode!

468246.overview:
Try as fast as possible to clean up the playfield, earn bonus time with speed combinations and discover all special items.

Fast endless Levels with special items and great graphics!

468248.overview: Trapped in a bubble you can only bounce and climb up. Your goal is to rise as high as you can while avoiding dangerous objects, insidious platforms and much more. Play alone for the record or against your friends in a funny multiplayer match!

468249.overview: A realistic physics simulated bowling game with charming graphics, immersive controls and supportive sound effects. Multiplayer mode supports up to 8 players.

468250.overview:
You take the role as an alien cowboy or a gigantic mutated brain as you fight your way through an onslaught of enemies, alone or with a friend, in this br00t4l top-down multidirectional shooter.

Awarded for "best execution" at Swedish Game Awards 2010, it features two full episodes as well as an intense survival mode, all playable either by yourself or with a friend in co-op mode.

468251.overview:
Br8kIn'; pronounced (Break In) is a remake of a classic console hit. This new version has been created using the HuskySoft engine with a progressive design. Gone are the simple blocks of yesterday, and your "paddle" is now as dynamic as the levels that you are using it in.

Enjoy!

468252.overview:
Play in 3D! Travel through distinct environments fighting intense bosses and mobs. Learn unique and creative skills to help you in your quest to save an endangered village.

You can go in alone or team up with friends in up to 4 player cooperative play!

468253.overview:
Jump start your brain! Exercise your math, words and puzzle skills across 11 different games.

Give your thumbs a rest and give your brain a workout by playing this game.

468256.overview: Jump start your brain! 10 challenging games including Sudoku, anagrams, odd one out, general knowledge and money.

468257.overview:
Test your knowledge in this time-based quiz game, with thousands of questions spread over 18 categories and three difficulty levels.

Give your thumbs a rest and jump start your brain!

468258.overview: Welcome into the Brain of Bob! Delve into Bob's world and help him on his quest to regain his sanity...all the while traversing your way through a mind bending version of reality. It's time to prove you have what it takes to conquer all 30 LEVELS that await you!

468259.overview: bricks4ever is a Breakout variant. The classic game mode is the closest to the usual mechanics: The player controls a paddle which is confined to the bottom of the screen and can move left or right. it is used to bounce a ball towards the blocks positioned all over the playing area. The goal is to destroy all blocks by hitting them with the ball - but failing to reach it with the paddle and letting it fall down the screen causes the loss of a life. Sometimes destroyed blocks leave behind power-ups which can be collected for beneficial temporary effects, e.g. the ball is glued to the paddle instead of bouncing off directly or the paddle becomes bigger. There are overall 50 levels and three additional playing modes: Zen (blocks move automatically downwards and the goal is to destroy as many of them as possible before the end is reached), 4ever (an endless mode) and bipolar (the player controls two paddles simultaneously with the two analogue sticks).

468260.overview: Realtime Strategy set during the Golden Age of Piracy with a unique control system built for the xbox controller. Use wind, terrain and different ship types to out manouver your enemies. Presented in 3D, moveable camera to get close in or take a long distance view. Multiple locations, times of day and weather conditions.

468261.overview:
Looking for a great way to keep your brain in shape? Brain Party is a puzzle-solving, brain-stretching game that comes with over 30 minigames designed to push your brain to its limits, testing memory, logic, mathematics, reactions and more.

Brain Party is split into two main modes: test mode gives you five random games to measure your general brain power, whereas practise mode lets you play your favourite games as often as you want.

As you play, more minigames are unlocked and Brain Party automatically tracks your test results so you can monitor your progress over time. If you do really well, you can unlock secret games and a whole new game mode designed to keep you playing and enjoying your favourite games even longer.

All the games in Brain Party are family safe and fun for all ages - here's the full list: Balloon Blaster, Bomb Hunt, BP Says, Bubble Trouble, Card Match, Connex, Dice Off, Flash Counting, Flashlight, IQ Test, Jewel Flip, Jewel Jam, Marble Drop, Memoryblox, Memory Box, Memory Maths, Mine Sweep, Moon Jump, Number Snake, Odd One Out, Perfect Paths, Route Finder, Rock Paper Scissors, Scrambled!, Set Finder, Sharpshooter, Short Sudoku, Shuffle Puzzler, Symbolic Logic, Teeter Totter, Under the Hat, Untangler and Word Smash.

Where else can you get so many games for such a low price? Brain Party lets you train your brain and have fun at the same time!

468262.overview: In this challenging 2D action platformer, the goal is to increase a sword's power by completing quests for the Smith, the Chemist and the Mage. There are many powers to explore, and some of them combine together to create new hidden abilities. You can only increase your weapon a set amount of times before putting it to the test, so choose your upgrades wisely!

468263.overview: It was supposed to be a simple arcade game, but something has broken down the barriers between game worlds. Can you resolve the mystery in this revealing Breakout-style game with a twist?

468264.overview: Prepare to go mind-numbingly fast as you Blast, Smash and Break Limit through every one and thing in your way! Powerful weapons that get stronger as you play, will help to power a ship that becomes an invincible wrecking ball while accelerating. Alpha Centauri will never be the same! Featuring online scoreboards for Gold subscribers, and local scoreboards to prove youre better than your siblings!

468265.overview: Breeze puts you in control of the wind as you gently blow a flower towards the goal. Master both tilt and touch controls to guide the flower across 60 seasonal themed levels while listening to Breeze's smooth, relaxing soundtrack. Add to your Xbox LIVE account's gamerscore by earning achievements. Breeze is light entertainment for all ages.

468268.overview: BrainBox360 (Physics Edition) is an Avatar Quiz for brainiacs and anyone trying to boost their brainpower. Scene It Pad compatible! You use it as a revision tool or just a bit of fun for the whole family. You'll be surprised just how much physics you already know and you'll definitely learn some along the way!

468269.overview: Avoid catastrophe by building bridges across dangerous chasms and rivers. Employ engineering skills to defeat the ever-present threat of physics!

468270.overview: Bubble Buster 360 is a re-imagining of a classic game mechanic. Protect your bubble cannon by popping surrounding bubbles before they get too close. With many levels of difficulty, from extremely easy to insanely difficult, over 60 levels, puzzle, endless, and time-attack modes, Bubble Buster 360 offers fun for the entire family!

468271.overview:
Bug Ball is a competitive volley ball style game for up to 4 Players on a single Xbox 360 or over Xbox Live!

Choose from a variety of adorable bugs, each with their own beautiful 3D arena. Jump, Spike, Dash and Super Spike your way to victory!

Who's the best Bug Ball player in the forest? It's time to find out!

468272.overview: Brixx is a traditional board game in a new exciting outfit. Aim of the game is to get more stones of your kind than your opponent. Both players move one after another. If it's your turn, you have to place an own stone on an empty field next to an opponent's stone so that this stone or a row of stones is between your stones. The game is over if no one can place a stone.

468273.overview:
Build 'n Bump is a local multiplayer, 2D head-stomping brawler where you build your own levels right before you play on them!

Inspired by the classic DOS game Jump 'n Bump, Build 'n Bump retains all of the same head-stomping, multiplayer fun with a twist. You can build your own levels right before you play on them!

468274.overview: Movement is restricted but weaponry is not. Bounce bullets off walls and use your shield to deflect incoming projectiles, but be warned, every bullet that you fire could bounce around and kill you. This is Bullet Trap. Take on 50 levels yourself or try working co-operatively with a friend. Try not to kill yourself, or each other, unless your playing one of the 12 Vs arena's of course.

468275.overview:
Brittle is a puzzle game about gaining points by moving across a map while avoiding dangers.

1-hit-kill enemies and a crumbling level stands between you and finishing each map.

468276.overview:
Long ago we settled down on this planet, the three of us. We each formed our own country, as we always do, and we always named them after ourselves.

The minerals of this particular planet had a different structure than what we were used to. It was more powerful and had an extra shine to them, we called them Pearls.

Our offspring all had this shimmering with a slightly different hue resembling the natural form of each of us. We'd never been so complete or happy before.

But then, one day one of us attacked the others.

Fly something resembling a space ship and defend yourself from the opposing forces and destroy air and land based creatures. A retro shooter as it was made in the 80s.

468277.overview: Bubble Buster is an addictive bubble breaker style game. Slide bubbles along the horizontal and vertical axis to get groups of the same color and make them explode. This game includes three different game modes (Level Mode, Time Trial and Biggest Bust) and includes a highscore table for each mode along with six awards to be earned throughout the game.

468278.overview: Battle your enemies with your farts. Eat food to fill your gas meter. Eat the kettle of beans for a "Silent But Deadly" that will kill any enemy. Fart near an open flame for an explosive kill. Find lighters to ignite your farts for a fiery jetting flame. Spit to distract enemies. Spit on flowers to grow them to reach higher platforms. 32 levels & 13 enemies!

468279.overview:
Bumblicity: It's a frantic head-to-head word game! Utilizing an army of bees, you must drop the letter tiles to spell words, chain combos and get as many points as you can!

Play against a friend or any of the CPU's 4 difficulty levels. Think fast and you'll never be at a loss for words!

468282.overview: Multi directional, level pattern, strategy shooter. Campaign and Practice modes. Global high scores.

468283.overview:
Crime solving game like no other. You are Agent Kendall. Hurled into the gritty world of arson, murderer and an anti-extremist extremist.

Original music score, full voice acting, cut scenes, multiple endings and crime scenes to explore.

468285.overview:
This action packed sequel to Bureau - Agent Kendall, stars a sexy FBI agent with special talents. The visually stimulating crime solving continues with enhanced puzzles and mind-bending clues.

Picking up from the last episode, Agent Kendall has become a rising star in the Bureau. She is confident and bold. The game now offers a new way to solve crimes and an improved smart phone.

468287.overview:
Brimstone is a top-down, Hack'n'Slash Role Playing Game for up to 8 players.

Procedurally generated dungeons, a huge variety of monsters and endless variations of loot ensure that no two sessions will ever be the same!

468288.overview:
A fast-paced multiplayer party game with blocks, spinning blades, and ghosts. Oh my!

Dodge the spinning blades while trying to trap your opponents with blocks! Each round is fully customizable, from how fast the blades move to how many blocks you can carry to the ability to turn into a ghost and seek revenge after you die.

468289.overview:
Burst the bubbles by connecting at least three of the same type. Earn bonuses for speed and breaking off chunks of other bubbles.

Work your way through the many levels and climb the online high score tables.

468290.overview:
Blaze the trail to the future! Fight for survival and aim for the role of God, The Filament!

Up to four clansmen, Gunslinger, Mage, Bomber and Hero! Kill your opponent for total domination! Disarray on the battlefield is no problem for a true God!

Can the world of Tungsten be yours?

468292.overview:
BULKHEAD Survival is an action packed survival FPS for single player and multiplayer online co-op.

How long can you survive against the increasingly skilled AI opponents?

468293.overview: A color-matching twist on the classic top-down scrolling shooter. Help bumblepig pollinate flowers and earn money to buy himself some fancy new clothes. Master the perfect lines through each level to earn top scores and unlock rewards.

468294.overview: In this unique, action-packed experience, defeat the terrorists and storm their desert base using the most advanced Ferret Weapons Technology...all while swinging from a helicopter in style!

468295.overview: Just for kids...an easy to play game with narration, so your children can have fun playing on their own. Easy to follow directions for one or two players. A game that will sure to be played over and over again as they race around the board to get their bunny to the carrot patch first!

468296.overview:
Can you stop the bugs? Zap them, spray them and explode them through 30+ levels of bug-filled mayhem!

How long can you last?

468297.overview:
Board a derelict space station to salvage a lost alien artifact. Unknown dangers await you in this atmospheric first person shooter.

Features LIVE multiplayer and singleplayer.

468298.overview:
Bumper Knights is fast-paced, action-brimming, trajectory-flinging fun!

Bounce your way through procedurally generated forests, villages, and castles to save the land from the forces of greed. Collect rare and powerful weapons in your favorite replayable quests. And most importantly, meet the infamously impressive band of Bumper Knights- Spring, Pierce, Appel, and Thud. Together we will win!

468299.overview:
From the makers of Platformance: Castle Pain comes a game about:
Bombs and bombers, skills and rankings, babes and bunkers: BUNKER BUSTER!
Blast your way through 32 levels of destruction madness.
Put your piloting skills to the test with planes, helicopters and missile launcher mounted jetpacks that cut through rocks like butter.
r Features:

- Destructible landscape
- Simple controls
- 6 different aircrafts with their own physics
- Local scoreboard
- Comic book style graphics
- A story with twists and turns
- Unlock missions as you go
- Destroy targets but avoid hostages
- Save your mission at any time
- Collect Rewards but avoid Flopwards!

468300.overview:
Go big or buzz home!

Bug Zapper is the adventure of Skeeter, the mosquito, as he defends his fellow bugs from the unstoppable lure of the Bug Zapper.

Punch and throw Bugs to their safety with up to 4 local players! Upgrade your Bug with special abilities, speed and strength to stop every bug from getting Zapped!

468301.overview: BugRace is a 1 to 4 player multiplication practice game. Playing like a board game, the object is to answer multiplication problems correctly so you can spin the wheel and advance around the board. Careful, if your unlucky ant lands on a red stone, an unfortunate accident will occur as a fully rendered animation, causing the player to miss a turn. How well do you know your multiplication tables?

468303.overview:
As Agent Kendall, you have been reassigned to work on a special crimes team. Things will never be the same again.

Welcome to a new type of adventure / story game.

468304.overview: Take the role of an angry and violent woodsman on a journey to take back what's his. Slash and carve your way through a bloody forest of ravenous creatures to track down the fabled Stag! Invite your friends along in this violently gory forest adventure. Team up against wolves, hunters and bears and fight your way to victory.

468306.overview: Explosive & relentless old skool arcade action where the object of the game is simple: use your paddle to hit and deflect the ball around the angles to destroy all coloured bricks, progressing through each stage while attempting to get the highest score you can. Scores are then shared with the community to see who comes top! The game features 3 themes and over 30 levels of non stop action.

468308.overview: Are you ready for a rush hour frenzy at the local diner? Burger Jack is a fast-paced, casual arcade game suitable for all ages. Serve customers as fast as you can, and help the teenage boy, Jack, earn money to buy the gadget hes been dreaming about.

468309.overview: Experience violence, political corruption and heroism. Where the actions you make, affect the outcome, but mostly you walk right and beat people up! + Play 2 player Co-op and use the buddy move to devastate the enemy. + Multiple endings. + Knock opponents into the air and keep them bouncing. + Save the city from the forces of evil.

468310.overview:
Burning Rubber is a fast paced retro racing game where the player must fight the other drivers while trying to come 1st place.

The game includes 24 different race tracks over 3 difficulty modes, a mix of different weapons and upgrades to buy for your car and random encounters where the player can either win or lose money.

468311.overview: The ultimate game of deception, quick reflexes and luck is here: ButtonHoldingExtravaganzaParty! This multiplayer game for 2 to 4 players will test your skills at deceiving your friends and holding buttons.

468312.overview: Memorize the the sequence of buttons and repeat it in an ever growing chain. Get it wrong and get a surprise. With 4 different play modes from Easy to Extreme(with only Easy available until purchase), Button Memory can appeal to anyone. So who can go the longest?! Is it you?

468313.overview: The computers randomly generated button press sequence and level up. Have your Avatar cheer you on. Strap on your virtual blindfold and try your luck with the dreaded blackout mode. Do your best and unlock challenges from the main game and follow your progress by checking out the stats menu. Become a Buttons top 100 champion!

468314.overview: Play as a safari hunter re-capturing animals that have escaped from RidKim Zoo. Play over 20 levels across 4 different terrains capturing some of the most dangerous and unusual animals. Try survivor mode to see just how long you can survive against a never ending barrage of animals.

469949.overview: Blast Off is an interstellar arcade game featuring gravity fields, lost astronauts and bizarre planetary systems. Use your rocket ship to rescue astronauts and carry them through the warpgate to safety. But be careful! The ever-present force of gravity can help you on your journey, but can also bring you crashing down.Each planet and celestial body within a level has a gravity effect which must be accounted for. This gravity must be used to the player’s advantage in combination with rocket boost power and directional control. Various hazards must be avoided, and if the ship crashes into an object the mission fails.- 45 missions across four difficulty settings.- Planets and Asteroids will have gravity and attract the ship, allowing players to float around the level.- Black Holes will attract the ship with even more ferocity.- White Holes have a reverse gravity field, pushing the ship away.- Mission success is ranked on several factors: remaining fuel, remaining air, astronauts collected.- Awarded Silver, Gold or Brick medals based on final mission outcome.Good luck and Blast Off!

481423.overview:
Break is an interactive allegory for the fall of communism and the reunification of Germany.

Using the state-of-the-art Blockington Blockworth engine, assume the mantle of a glorious oblong warrior and crush the Marxists with your balls.

481441.overview: The object of Blast is to shoot the ball through a series of moving systems. Shoot the ball from the current green barrel to the yellow barrel using the barrels in between. The game speeds up each level so shoot carefully!

481454.overview:
1920 and the city is in sight. Drop your bombs to level the city and then move onto the next.

Unlimited levels - see how far you can go!

Authentic 1920 jazz soundtrack - immerse yourself in the time period!

Stunning visual style - relax and enjoy the sights!

481455.overview:
Be careful of the wind!!

To clear a stage, pile up the blocks to the line. BUT never forget to collect stars!

Is there a secret ending!?

481510.overview:
Blobs is an action puzzle game. Catch the blobs and then fire them back at the invading blob army, but be careful they are only weak against blobs of the same colour.

Blobs includes three game modes, each with difficulty options, scoreboards and trophies!

482422.overview: Build A Buddy turns an object scanned with Kinect into a living digital character. Body movements animate the new creature and let it take part in short playful scenes.

482457.overview: Kinect creates a caricature of the player as a figure with an oversized, wobbling head. Choose costumes and poses to make short comic scenes with the personalised character.

482479.overview: Scan household objects with Kinect to turn them into unusual fighters. Simple gestures choose attacks, counters and grabs in battles built around a rock-paper-scissors style of decision making.
